    card = Card(
        id="card-1",
        note_id="note-1",
        state=CardState.REVIEW,

                reviewed_at=dt(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0),

                seconds=15,
                state_before=CardState.REVIEW,

        ),
    )

    today = date(2026, 3, 10)
    settings = SchedulerSettings(learning_steps_days=(2, 5))
    card = make_review_card(interval_days=6, ease=1.4, lapses=3)

    assert card == make_review_card(interval_days=6, ease=1.4, lapses=3)

    assert result.id == card.id
    assert result.note_id == card.note_id
    assert result.buried_until == card.buried_until
    assert result.history == card.history
